title: Alaska and Hawaii Expedited Shipments: Home Delivery Pharmacy Carrier Zone Table
content:
## Carrier zone table: remote destinations

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited order, a remote-destination surcharge is added when the shipping ZIP code on the account lies in Alaska (99500 through 99999) or Hawaii (96700 through 96899): 15.00 when the shipment went out overnight to such a ZIP code, 7.50 when it went out two-day to such a ZIP code, and nothing in every other case. The surcharge is added to the expedited fee charged on that order.

The ZIP code read is the shipping ZIP code recorded on the home delivery account; the service read is the shipping method on the order's shipment record, that is, how the shipment actually went out.

### Remote ZIP ranges (inclusive at both ends)

| Zone | First ZIP | Last ZIP |
|---|---|---|
| Alaska | 99500 | 99999 |
| Hawaii | 96700 | 96899 |

### Surcharge by service

| Shipment went out | Account ZIP in a remote range | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Overnight | Yes | 15.00 |
| Two-day | Yes | 7.50 |
| Overnight or two-day | No | none |
| Any other service | either | none |

### Boundary ZIP codes (hypothetical accounts, overnight shipment)

| Account ZIP | In range | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 99499 | No | none |
| 99500 | Yes (Alaska) | 15.00 |
| 96699 | No | none |
| 96700 | Yes (Hawaii) | 15.00 |
| 96899 | Yes (Hawaii) | 15.00 |
| 96900 | No | none |

The same ZIP codes with a two-day shipment carry 7.50 where they are in range.
